title: Figure 23: Illustration of atrial septal defect repair with a Gore Teflon-based patch
description: Color medical illustration showing a catheter delivering a disc-shaped Teflon-based occluder patch through a hole in the heart's atrial wall. Caption: "Figure 23. Illustration of Treatment of an Atrial Septal Defect Using a Teflon-Based Product Manufactured by Gore, Inc." The text describes it as an artist's conception of the catheter-inserted patch for infants with septal defects.
